## Seat review of PR #32931 at `131de9d7` · REWORK round 1 · 2026-11-13T04:07Z

Claim 6838546284 stands; same branch, same card thread. Trigger: the epic seat's red-line read 6840905752 on the PR, verdict NO PASS with one must-fix (M1), to be fixed in this PR.

- **Finding M1 (blocking):** a package pick survives a re-seed of the open create form. With a `sys_user_permission_set` create form open and a package holder picked, a host that changes `initialData`/`initialValues` to another `permission_set` resets the form; `permission_set` takes the new seed but `permission_set_package` is put back by the reset carry in `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx` (the `carried` filter around `form.reset(defaultValues)`), because the #32795 seed rule keeps that key out of every create seed. In three of four measured cases this PR turns a 409 into a stored grant of a holder the user never picked for that name.
- **Seat ruling, how to fix:** fix it once, in the shared carry, so the modal, drawer, full-page and tabbed forms are all fixed by one change. The carry must not put back a package qualifier whose paired name field the reset changed (outgoing value ≠ incoming value of the paired key). Read the pairing from the existing column/object pairing the widget already uses; do not hard-code `permission_set_package` in the generic renderer if that pairing is reachable from it. If it is not reachable without a layering breach, take the epic seat's second arm instead: the widget drops a stored package when the name changed by a path other than its own pick. Say in the report which arm and why.
- **Do not** seed the key as `null`: that flips #32795's "the key is absent" pins.
- **Owed pins:** the re-seed composition on all four forms (modal, drawer, full-page, tabbed): after a package pick, a re-seed to another name sends the name alone and shows no stale holder. Keep the wizard (ignores re-seed) and close-and-reopen as CONTROLs. Ablation leg: the carry put back as before turns the four pins red.
- **Reach:** because the fix covers the full-page and tabbed forms (on unreleased main since #32793), no separate p1 card is owed under #32795.
- **Not this round:** the epic seat's two nits go to a follow-up card under #32833; R1–R3 are routed by the epic seat to one p2 card under #32795.
- **File surface amendment:** `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx` (or the permission-ref widget file, per the arm chosen) plus their test files; the changeset FROM→TO gains the re-seed line.
